notes.title: Ubinota - Update 1
notes.content:
- put the "slice of bread" level in the first chapter (a nice one)
- totally change the last level of the first chapter
- make the "hidden tree" level clearer
- make the first hard level of the game more difficult (some players were beating it by accident)
- now, the first level "hook" must be done with the hook
- the hard "hook" level is now harder
- the first "second coat" level can't be beaten with the hook technic anymore
- the "seagull" level is now clearer
- the "eel" level is now clearer
- fix a level of the last chapter, succeeding in the level was not fun
- fix the option menu that was broken in French
- fix an achievement that was not working properly
- the "!" symbols stay displayed when the level is beaten
- invert the replay button and the speed up button, because players instinctively clic to the right right to speed up
